profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at FinTech | Masters Degree in Software Engineering | Fullstack Java, Azure, and React Developer | Posse Scholar
profile.summary: Dynamic Senior Software Engineer with over 4 years of experience in developing robust applications and optimizing cloud-hosted solutions. Proficient in Java, Spring Boot, and Kubernetes, with a proven track record of reducing cycle times and enhancing deployment efficiencies. Successfully implemented a Google Cloud application that improved customer profit margins, showcasing strong analytical and algorithm design skills. Eager to leverage expertise and contribute innovative solutions that drive excellence in software development.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Designed and Implemented Google Cloud-hosted application that optimized CME Customer portfolios on demand by using proprietary Quants based algorithms to improve their profit margins based on cached daily market data. 
•	Created an internal messaging load balancer that routes requests from external APIs and Google Cloud Pub/Sub topics to a multitude of internal services which resulted in a reduction of cycle times through concurrent processing and increased fault-tolerant scenarios.
•	Deployed custom CI/CD Pipelines following DevOps Principles to tackle convoluted and slow deployment times which resulted in daily continuous deployments for faster turnaround of code feedback.

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.description:
•	Integrated a secure logging database with an existing in-house application using React, Java, and Spring Boot to allow for fast and secure access to essential transaction logging data accessible to both internal and external users.
•	Engineered a live service application that listened to Kafka topics for margining trades allowing users to see real-time profit and loss metrics following a buy/sell action.
•	Migrated an On-Premises Microservices Based Application to Google Cloud through automated Kubernetes deployments and containerized Docker images.

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Skills: Oracle Database · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Kubernetes · Kafka Streams · Cucumber · Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) · Maven · Jenkins · Redis · Spring Framework

positions.title: Software Engineer I
positions.description: Skills: Oracle Database · Kafka Streams · Cucumber · Maven · Jenkins · Redis · Spring Framework

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Created tools to consume machine-readable files, tie them together, and create a consistent, human-readable representation of each step that each piece of data takes in a given workflow.
- Developed enterprise software, working with a team of Analysts, that interacts with internal and vendor-supplied applications through web service APIs.
-  Placed 1st as a team in a technology-wide Intern Hack-a-thon where our team developed a trading algorithm which returned a remarkable profit from a variety of CME markets.
positions.insights: Skills: Oracle Database · Cucumber · Maven · Jenkins · Spring Framework

positions.title: Information Technologies Student Supervisor
positions.description:
- Facilitate contact between students, faculty, and staff alike and the professional on-campus ITS
Teams as the front desk attendee and first face of the ITS conglomerate.
- Manage and log in requests, calls, and emails into our ticketing management system according to
specified standards.
- Receive extensive training on Mac and Windows Software and Hardware Support, Network
Connectivity support, and customer service by working closely with experts and other Student
Consultants.

positions.title: Software Engineering Summer Fellow
positions.description:
- Embedded on an agile development team working on TPS (Theoretical Pricing System), a low-latency, message based system of Java applications which produce intraday prices for all of the instrument traded on CME’s Globex trading platform. As part of the team, I attended daily stand-ups and bi-weekly agile planning meetings. 
- Developed Kafka-based message injector which was used to send test messages into the Pricing Engine.
- As part of the intern fellowship program, collaboratively developed a message-based pricing system.
- Participated and won Team MVP Award in a technology-wide Intern Hack-a-thon where our team developed a trading algorithm which returned a remarkable profit from a variety of CME markets and placed 4th among all teams.

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
- Spearheaded a company-wide BitLocker Implementation Project in which I lead a team of technicians towards fully encrypting every computer in the company’s domain through the use of Azure and Active Directory. 
- Cataloged and updated the company’s user database by personally collaborating with every manager in order to ensure accuracy and uniformity. Developed a PowerShell script that would update the user information in Active Directory utilizing Excel for future company need. 
- Validated the Business Continuity Plan through close interactions with managers and departmental bosses to standardize effective backup plans in case of disaster.
